case.summary: Customer C09988 reported an unauthorized online purchase of $59.67 made on December 11, 2016, via card C09988-K1. The transaction originated from a new and previously unseen device profile using Edge 16.0 on Windows. The fraud model assigned a high probability score of 0.692 to the transaction, and the cardholder explicitly denied making the purchase. Consequently, blocking the card with L1 team lead approval is recommended.
